gen-dafont-lemon-milk-fs-epilogue: Wide, loose and friendly: Lemon Milk lays out rounded, rolling-ball-pen letters, while Epilogue below stays wiry, curvy and approachable. Lemon Milk earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-fs-public-sans: Trustworthy Public Sans brings a hefty lowercase with broad open counters, while Lemon Milk spreads its rounded, loosely tracked letters up top. The friendliest thing here is Lemon Milk's wide, ink-trail roundness.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-general-sans: Lemon Milk spreads out wide and friendly, its rounded letters drawn with the single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen. General Sans handles the text with smooth bends and a tall x-height, so the heading can go bigger.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-switzer: Friendly Lemon Milk runs wide and loose in rounded letters, while Switzer keeps to tubular, wire-like forms and a tall waist line. Lemon Milk leads loudly and Switzer carries the talking.
gen-megrim-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Angular and futuristic, Megrim leads with thin, measured strokes. Pilcrow Rounded brings warm, open curves and big counters in a tall lowercase, so the two feel like sharp angles meeting a soft handshake.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-familjen-grotesk: Nostalgic Mystery Quest wears open jaws on its curves and compact ascenders, while Familjen Grotesk leaves its bowls unfinished on one side. Old-book charm meets a lively, sans-serif modern voice.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-aleo: Aleo, a dignified serif, lets the eye slip in and out. Chubbo excels at casual, marker-drawn friendliness in a plain unmodulated outline, whereas Aleo is at its best with classic, dignified text.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-almendra-sc: Almendra SC holds an authoritative, dignified tone with open-mouthed letterforms, while Chubbo's heading letters look drawn with a marker tip. Paragraphs here would feel stately, and the open mouths keep them inviting.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-antic-slab: Dignified Antic Slab draws round bowls with uniform walls and wide, barely curled s curves, beneath Chubbo's casual marker-tip heading. Reading on would feel editorial and steady, never fussy or ornate.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-fenix: Chubbo draws casual, marker-tip letters with n arches matching the stems beside them, while Fenix ends its curves before they turn inward. Casual, inviting weight meets classic, editorial restraint in the text.
